items.title: Vertiv CEO: How Google, Meta, Microsoft earnings are 'reinforcing' data center acceleration
items.summary: Vertiv (VRT) stock is rebounding after the company reported quarterly earnings. Vertiv CEO Giordano "Gio" Albertazzi sits down with Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman to discuss Vertiv's demand from AI hyperscalers, data center backlash, and more.

items.title: Microsoft stock surges on earnings: A closer look at Copilot, Azure, and capex
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) stock is jumping after the company reported surging cloud growth. Morning Brief host Julie Hyman chats with Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley about the results.

items.title: Should Greg Abel’s Cash Strategy After Buffett’s Exit Require Action From Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) Investors?
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway has entered a new era after Warren Buffett’s retirement as CEO at the end of 2025, with successor Greg Abel now overseeing a record US$397 billion cash pile, heavy share buybacks, and recent moves such as the Taylor Morrison acquisition and a US$10 billion Alphabet investment. items.title: AMZN Stock Rises After Q2, AWS Beat: CEO Says Even Higher CapEx Won’t Be Enough To Meet Soaring Cloud Demand
items.summary: “We will still not have enough capacity to meet all the demand we have in 2026,” Amazon CFO Kaven Parekh said.

items.title: Reddit (RDDT) Beats Q2 Estimates As AI Advertising Grows And Search Risks Emerge
items.summary: Reddit (NYSE:RDDT) reported Q2 results that surpassed its earnings estimates, supported by rapid expansion in AI-driven advertising. The company highlighted a rising advertiser base using its AI tools to target Reddit’s interest-based communities. Management also flagged ongoing risks tied to search-driven traffic volatility and unresolved Google data licensing terms for AI training. items.title: 3 Reasons Alphabet Is the Most Underrated "Magnificent Seven" Stock
items.summary: Alphabet may be the market's most overlooked AI leader, offering investors a rare mix of rapid growth, bargain valuation, and valuable hidden assets that could reward patient shareholders.
